dynamic-element.dynamic-content: RA to be initiated after 24 hours

dynamic-element.name: Text50680698
dynamic-element.dynamic-content: Some cases have been reported where bidders have claimed non receipt of prior intimation of RA start. In order to ensure that no prospective eligible bidder is left out due to non intimation on time, it has been decide that RA will henceforth start 24 hours after the buyer proceeds for the RA creation and initiated RA. RA Start date and End Date will be notified to both buyer and sellers.
खरीदार की पहल के 24 घंटे बाद रिवर्स नीलामी शुरू होती है। जेम दोनों पक्षों को आरंभ और समाप्ति की तारीखें बताता है।
